## OpenUtau Mobile 1.0.0

> **Vibe-coded with AI.** The additions in this build (Custom resamplers, Auto pitch, Harmony generator and piano roll video export) were written by [Claude](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Anthropic's AI, Claude Sonnet 5.5), directed by sparky-commits1637. The code has not been hand-reviewed, and the new features have not been tested on a device by the author, so please report problems.

### What's new in 1.0.0
- **Export piano roll video.** In the editor, open the **⋮** menu and choose **Export piano roll video** to render your song as a scrolling piano roll video. You can pick landscape, portrait or a custom size, 24 to 60 fps, and whether to include the audio mix and the singer's portrait. It is rendered offline frame by frame, so long songs take a while. Keep the app open until it finishes. Android only.
- **Out of beta.** The app is now named **OpenUtau Mobile** again (no more "Custom Resampler" label) and reports version **1.0.0** instead of `0.0.0-local`.

### Updating
- This build is signed with the same key as the previous release, so it installs over it and keeps your data.
- If you are coming from a release before v0.4, those used a different signing key. Uninstall that copy first, which erases its data, so back up your projects.
- The package name is unchanged, so it still installs separately from the official OpenUtau Mobile.
- Android **ARM64** only. Please report problems with the log from **Options → Export Log**.
